# Vendored files

Do not edit these files here. They are copies of the canonical sources in the
[EngineeredByTheNumbers](https://github.com/billvanloo/EngineeredByTheNumbers) repository, `ecosystem/` folder.
Change them there, then run `node scripts/sync-vendor.js` in that repository to update this tool
(both this folder and the inline copies in `index.html`). `dev/verify-html.js` fails if they drift.
